invariants.rationale: Method creates HoodieData from records; null records may be disallowed or handled as a programming error.
Method returns non-null HoodieListData instance for any valid input list.
Method implementation returns HoodieListData.lazy(records), so result is always of this type.
HoodieListData should preserve the number of elements from input records list.
Assuming HoodieListData.collectAsList() returns the input list unchanged due to .lazy(records).
